name: Mirror Hall
description: In a vintage hall of mirrors, the reflections step out of the glass and walk on their own.

wardrobe.man: a burgundy velvet jacket, a black shirt and black trousers
wardrobe.woman: a burgundy velvet jacket, a black shirt and black trousers
wardrobe.person: a burgundy velvet jacket, a black shirt and black trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} stands in the middle of a narrow vintage carnival hall of mirrors, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}. Tall ornate mirrors in gilded frames line both walls, each one holding a reflection of the {subject}, warm bare bulbs hang from the ceiling, and the wooden floor is worn. Medium-wide shot at eye level, perfectly symmetrical, the {subject} centered with three mirrors on each side. Cinematic photography, warm tungsten bulbs, soft reflections, a touch of haze. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, clean mirror glass and plain gilded frames throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands still in the center of the hall, eyes on a point just past the camera. The reflections in the mirrors stop copying {them}: one by one, the surface of each mirror ripples like water and an identical copy of the {subject} steps out of the glass into the hall, exactly six copies in total, three from each side, all in the same burgundy jacket, and they walk in and form a line beside the original, so that by the last second seven identical figures stand side by side facing the camera. The camera dollies back slowly to fit the line. Sound: glass rippling like water, footsteps multiplying on the wooden floor, a faint carnival hum. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, mirror surfaces with real reflections and ripples, sharp detail, stable picture.
